body.statement: For every \(M\in MC(A,B)\), independence gives \(PM(Xn=0,Zn=0)=w00\), \(PM(Xn=0,Zn=1)=w01\), \(PM(Xn=1,Zn=0)=w10\), and \(PM(Xn=1,Zn=1)=w11\). Regime consistency gives \(a=s(0,0)+s(0,1)\), \(b=s(0,0)+s(1,0)\), and \(q=a+b-c+d\). Consequently the admissible success masses are exactly parameterized at the mass-accounting level by \(cL\le c\le cU\) and \(0\le d\le w11\).
body.justification: This reduction isolates the only two free masses without discarding the independence of the two latent sources.
body.gap: Generic response-function programs retain many latent probabilities; no checked source states this four-stratum reduction for the two experimental tables.
body.consumer: The reduction is the symbolic presolver used by the constant-time certificate procedure.
